# Provider marks

SVG provider and model marks are sourced unchanged from [Lobe Icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons), packages/static-svg/icons, retrieved 23 October 2026. The upstream license is included in LICENSE. Marks remain the property of their respective owners.

- Anthropic models: claude-color.svg
- OpenAI: openai.svg
- Google model: gemini-color.svg
- Alibaba model: qwen-color.svg
- Moonshot model: kimi-color.svg
- Meta: meta-color.svg
- DeepSeek: deepseek-color.svg
- Grok: grok.svg
- Z.ai: zai.svg
- Xiaomi model: xiaomimimo.svg

These marks identify entries in the demo catalog and do not imply endorsement.
